name: ToolJet
description_en: ToolJet is the open-source foundation of ToolJet AI - the enterprise app generation platform for building internal tools, dashboard, business applications, workflows and AI agents 🚀
readme_excerpt: ToolJet is the open-source foundation of ToolJet AI - the AI-native platform for building and deploying internal tools, workflows and AI agents. The community edition provides a powerful visual builder, drag-and-drop UI, and integrations with databases, APIs, SaaS apps, and object storage. For AI-powered UI generation, query building, debugging, and enterprise features, see ToolJet AI. :star: If you find ToolJet useful, please consider giving us a star on GitHub! Your support helps us continue…
